chart_title: Intelligence Index vs. Cost to Run Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
x_axis: Cost to Run Intelligence Index (USD, Log Scale)
cost_unit: USD to run all Intelligence Index evaluations

universe.selection_evidence: The chart's model selector displayed '155 of 155 models' after Select all (it showed '28 of 155 models' before). The chart SVG held 136 circles and one dotted Pareto path (stroke-dasharray '0.1 6') with 20 M/L coordinate pairs, each matching a circle centre exactly.

method: research/2026-11-26-recapture/capture_chart.mjs: Playwright (headless Chromium 1600 x 1200; no sign-in; optional cookies declined). The chart's model selector set to Select all; every circle centre and the dotted Pareto path read from the chart SVG; each circle hovered at its on-screen centre from a neutral point and its public tooltip recorded verbatim. No embedded payload, API, export or paid data was used for the chart values; owner URLs come from AA's own model pages (each family page embeds its variants' {slug, name, shortName}).

precision.intelligence_index: Rounded integer displayed by public tooltip; raw precision is not recovered from SVG coordinates.
precision.total_cost_usd: Two decimal places displayed by public tooltip.

duplicate_resolution: None needed: every circle-centre hover returned a distinct tooltip (136 distinct for 136 circles).

comparison_to_previous_capture.basis: Both captures are Intelligence Index v5.0; vertices are compared by name (the previous release's capture is previous-frontier-capture.json; the cutoff moved under O65 for O145).

near_frontier_policy.basis: Public rounded integer Intelligence Index and two-decimal USD total cost from the chart tooltips. The frontier's intelligence at a point's cost is the highest intelligence among rendered-frontier points whose cost is at or below that cost; a point cheaper than every frontier point has no gap.

frontier.footnote: Claude Haiku 5.5 has 5x higher pricing on longer-context inputs which are not currently reflected; we are working to include this in cost figures across Artificial Analysis.
